'''Oh'dvek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Master Oh'dvek equipped [[Jedi Consular]]s with gear<ref name="TOR" /> on [[Keylander Station]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]],<ref name="ROTHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref> as well as during the [[Seizure of CZ-198]], inside the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] facility [[CZ-198]].<ref name="Titans">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/titans_of_industry|text=TITANS OF INDUSTRY}}</ref>
